{{Quote|We have uncovered a plot by the Rebel Alliance to move supplies into and out of Derra IV.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>}}
'''Derra IV''', or '''Derra Four''',<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> also known simply as '''Derra''',<ref name="AC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Derra system/Legends|Derra system]] of the [[Mikaster sector/Legends|Mikaster sector]], located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was a minor world of little value and had been relatively overlooked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This made it an ideal site for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operations.

==History==
Since before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Derra IV had been the site of an outpost and storage dump for the Rebellion.

As of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], its Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] was [[Dol Donar II]]. Donar hated the Alliance with a passion, until he found his demise that same year.<ref name="DF:SftE" />

Early in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] just days before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was the site of a crushing [[Battle of Derra IV|ambush]] in which Imperial forces destroyed a vital Rebel convoy and its escorts on their way to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The ambush was led by (and credit claimed by) [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], but masterminded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Derra IV in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]], which is actually located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
